title: Satellite Pass Schedule for Today
dataSources: APRS packets (`aprs:packet`), WSPR spots (`wspr:spot`), satellite passes (`satpass:prediction`), NOAA APT captures (`noaa:apt`), meteor-scatter pings (`meteorscatter:ping`), SSTV images (`sstv:image`).
app: Software-defined radio and ham-radio stations — APRS igate, WSPR beacon, NOAA weather-satellite (APT) receiver, meteor-scatter monitor, and SSTV decoder — logging to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=satpass:prediction
| eval mins_away=round((pass_epoch-now())/60,0)
| where mins_away>0 AND mins_away<720
| sort mins_away
| table satellite pass_epoch mins_away max_elevation
description: Lists the upcoming satellite passes over your station today so you never miss a good reception or spotting window.
value: Passes are brief and infrequent; a clear same-day schedule means you are set up and recording before the satellite rises.
implementation: Ingest pass predictions for your satellites of interest; schedule daily and surface today's passes by time.
visualization: Table of today's passes with time-away and maximum elevation.
grandmaExplanation: It lists when satellites will pass overhead today, so you are ready to catch their signals.
